failures.question: Can I still use static API keys in the X-API-Key header?
failures.answer: Send the access token in the Authorization header as a Bearer token. [1] Version 2.1 authenticated requests with a static API key sent in the X-API-Key header. [2]

failures.question: How much does an equity order cost?
failures.answer: TradeFlow supports market, limit, stop, and stop-limit orders. [1] A market order executes at the best available price and does not guarantee the fill price; fast markets can cause slippage. [1] Stock splits adjust position quantity and cost basis automatically on the effective date. [2]
